description: What can be recorded about one set of an exercise. The unit is the canonical unit for data exchange.

terms.label: Load
terms.definition: Kilograms; see the load object for what the number means.

terms.label: Calories
terms.definition: Kilocalories, as a machine reports them.

terms.label: Resistance level
terms.definition: A machine setting without a unit.

terms.label: Band tension
terms.definition: A named band colour or level.

terms.label: Tempo
terms.definition: Eccentric, pause, concentric and top pause in seconds, as in 3-1-1-0.
